يبتدعون (form VIII)
# يَبْتَدِعُونَ (yabtadiʕūna) /jab.ta.di.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
# يُبْتَدَعُونَ (yubtadaʕūna) /jub.ta.da.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَدَعَ (ibtadaʕa)
